Chapter 275: Chapter 18: In a Hurry for a Century, Numerous Beings, All Watching One Person (Please Subscribe)

For a moment.

Heaven and earth seemed to collapse.

It was as if all things were destroyed.

Lin Yuan gathered his two Primordial Spirits, and with all his might, he struck.

He completely surpassed the Sixth Rank limit, and purely in terms of might, perhaps he was already close to the Seventh Rank.

A moment later.

...

The nature’s spiritual energy gradually calmed.

Lin Yuan looked down.

“It’s a pity.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

His full-strength attack had still not breached Mount Morality Immortal.

“Well then.”

Lin Yuan did not care much.

The Daode Immortal Sect, with its inheritance spanning hundreds of thousands of years, had profound secrets, and unless a Unity Realm True Immortal or a Seventh Rank Evolver intervened,

it would be very difficult to completely break through their Sect Protection Array.

Lin Yuan’s visit this time was not to permanently resolve the Daode Immortal Sect.

Instead, it was to test his own strength, using the entire Daode Immortal Sect as a standard to measure against.

“Although I can’t break it, I have almost done it.”

“As long as I cultivate to the peak of the Sixth Rank, full force, my attack might touch upon the Seventh Rank.”

“By then, I should be able to completely break through Mount Morality Immortal.”

Lin Yuan looked down at Mount Morality Immortal, pondering to himself.

Of course.

The premise of Lin Yuan’s prediction.

Is that the legendary ‘Spirit Realm’ does not intervene.

The Daode Immortal Sect controls the ‘Ascension Platform’, and its past Ancient Saints, after leading the sect for ten or twenty thousand years, ascend to the ‘Spirit Realm’ via the platform.

Tens of thousands of years ago, many powerful beings from that era, some surpassing the Void Refinement Limit, have already ascended to a higher level of the Spirit Realm through the ‘Ascension Platform’.

In the Spirit Realm, it’s almost certain that there resides a Unity Path Stage True Immortal.

However.

The Ascension Platform is a one-way passage.

The former members of the Daode Immortal Sect who ascended can’t return from there.

This is also why Lin Yuan dared to take action against the Daode Immortal Sect.

With the two realms separated, even if they could intervene, the force they could exert would be very limited, and Lin Yuan, being undefeated in this realm, has nothing to fear from them.

“Let’s go back.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Daode Immortal Sect beneath him.

And then he disappeared.

Actually.

Lin Yuan could have left behind a Yang Spirit or a Yin God to continue suppressing the Daode Immortal Sect.

But there was no need.

With the combat power he had just displayed.

Even without leaving a suppressive avatar, the disciples of the Daode Immortal Sect would probably not dare to venture out for a long time,

especially those Nascent Soul True Monarchs and Mahayana Heavenly Monarchs.

Even if you gave them ten times the courage, they wouldn’t dare step outside the bounds of Mount Morality Immortal.

So, in that case,

it might as well be that both of his Primordial Spirits return together, as training the Primordial Spirit could also improve Lin Yuan’s efficiency in understanding dao.

…

Accompanied by Lin Yuan’s departure,

within Mount Morality Immortal, countless immortal sect disciples cried tears of relief.

Just now, they really felt the threat of death, thinking the Daode Immortal Sect, with its heritage of hundreds of thousands of years, might actually not withstand the attack of that Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc?

But now,

Mount Morality Immortal had not been breached.

And that figure, standing high in the sky, looking down on them like a True Immortal, Wuji, had also disappeared, likely having left.

“We have survived.”

“Hahaha, I knew my life wasn’t supposed to end.”

“We survived, we really survived.”

Countless Immortal Sect disciples couldn’t help but celebrate wildly.

From life to death, and from death back to life, such great fluctuations, even for cultivators, could inevitably affect their state of mind.

…

“Survived?”

Above in the sky, Jun Wuji watched the disciple’s wild celebration and couldn’t help feeling a bit bitter.

Since when had the lofty disciples of the Daode Immortal Sect expressed such sentiments?

“Go find the Sect Master.”

He composed himself and immediately flew towards the top of Mount Morality Immortal.

For ordinary disciples, indeed, they had survived.

But for the higher-ups of the Immortal Sect, it was just the beginning.

What the Immortal Sect needs to do next is crucial.

Wuji had only left, not died; it was far from a time for celebration.

…

The grand hall at the top of Mount Morality Immortal.

Sect Master Mu Qingliu sat in the main seat,

his eyes closed, frowning in deep thought.

“Sect Master.”

Mu Mengting appeared in the hall, bowing slightly to Mu Qingliu.

“Meng Ting,

Mu Qingliu opened his eyes and looked at Mu Mengting.

Observing the respectful demeanor of Mu Mengting, Mu Qingliu subconsciously compared him to Jun Dongjin.

And found the two simply couldn’t compare.

“Did I really choose wrong…” Mu Qingliu thought silently to himself.

If he had not chosen Mu Mengting to be the next Immortal Sect leader but had chosen Jun Dongjin instead,

would they have avoided the disaster that had just befallen the Daode Immortal Sect?

Although it’s true that Lin Yuan wanted to spread Martial Tao, a point on which he definitely won’t compromise and neither would the Daode Immortal Sect,

if Jun Dongjin had been the leader of the Immortal Sect, there would have been at least some room for easing the situation, instead of it escalating to direct conflict like just now.

“Sect Master, what should we do now?”

Mu Mengting asked cautiously.

“What should we do?”

Mu Qingliu focused his thoughts, “Wuji’s strength is beyond us now; we can only seek the advice of our ancestors…”

“The ancestors’ opinions?”

Mu Mengting’s eyes lit up.

The Daode Immortal Sect had been inherited for hundreds of thousands of years and had no less than thirty generations of leaders.

On average, each leader ruled the Immortal Sect for only ten to twenty thousand years.

Why is that?

It must be known that an Ancient Saint of Refinement Void’s lifespan far exceeds twenty thousand years, as the three Ancient Saints from the Blood Demon Sea, Nether Palace, and Demon Saint’s Nest have lived from that era until now.

It’s not difficult for an Ancient Saint of Refinement Void to live for several hundred thousand years.

But in reality, the Daode Immortal Sect has had many leaders, and the reason is the ‘Spirit Realm.’

The Daode Immortal Sect controls the ‘Ascension Platform’, a passage linking to the ‘Spirit Realm’, and its past leaders ascended to the Spirit Realm through it.
